attributes.name: Eando Kline
attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveal this card and recharge a card to examine the top card of your location deck; you may ignore non-villain powers that happen when you examine the card. Then you may recharge the item Wayfinder from your discard pile.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, you may evade cards you encounter.
